audit.granularity: Policy/guidance document, consultation notice, monitoring-period record, regeneration framework, or news/admin announcement.
required_caveats: Use as administrative planning-policy/regeneration-framework evidence only.
Do not treat policy, guidance, consultation, monitoring, strategy or framework records as evidence of physical delivery.
Replace representative points with reviewed boundaries if these records are ever displayed as spatial policy areas.
audit.ingestion_recommendation: Candidate-level ingestion after policy/event taxonomy review and duplicate review.
